integrity: The lower bound is taken from exact identities in the focal source. The new upper bound is a symbolic entropy estimate valid for every finite coordinate projection and every vector; no finite experiment, timeout, or numerical approximation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The bounds determine the logarithmic growth order but leave a factor-of-two gap in the leading logarithmic coefficient. They apply to the original quasi-norm family and do not assert the same explicit constants for arbitrary equivalent p-renormings.
title: Logarithmic suppression conditionality in a semi-greedy non-quasi-greedy Markushevich basis
